# Law 130: WRAP

| --- | --- |
| Index | 130 |

| Color | SLATE |
| Status | wired |
| Solver gate references | 2 |
| Help source | MECHANICS_HELP |

## Parameters

`POS_X/Y/Z (Stride 0-2)`, `VEL_X/Y/Z (Stride 3-5)`, `TOROIDAL (World)`, `WALL_REFLECT (World)`

## Four-tier help

| Tier | Content |
| --- | --- |
| HINT | The world edges wrap or bounce. |
| EXPLANATION | With WRAP on, a particle that leaves one face of the world re-enters through the opposite one and keeps its velocity. With WRAP off, the same face stops it: WALL REFLECT decides whether it is absorbed, mirrored or over-reflected. |
| SYSTEM | Each axis is folded back into [0, world size) when the law is on. When it is off, an out-of-range axis is clamped to the face and its outward velocity is scaled by WALL REFLECT. |
| ADVANCED | The TOROIDAL EDGES world param is this law\ |
